propositions: The completion verifier returns a dependency-link record instead of a CompletionVerdict when the model's reply quotes a Dep record in prose before emitting a valid verdict.
The root cause is schema-blind selection: tolerant_parse returns the first JSON object that parses rather than the first that satisfies the target schema.
The defect is structural—selection policy is deliberate and shared across all LLM gates (plan-review, overlap, epic-bug-screen), making the fix scope larger than a mechanical type correction.

Fixing this requires atomic shipping of extraction with an unambiguous sentinel channel and schema-filtered candidate selection, because the current directive instructs models to emit unfenced output, making a schema-blind first-fence selector more likely to fail on quoted material.
E1-E4 experiments prove that native structured output is unavailable for agentic tools with thinking enabled on Bedrock, so the prompted path must be hardened rather than replaced.
